title: Maré: orders under load
summary: Checkout writes each order once and announces it on one feed; the warehouse, carriers, invoices and an assistant each listen and fail alone.

steps.title: Checkout writes once
steps.caption: A shopper pays and checkout saves the order once, then answers right away, whatever the partners are doing.
steps.engineering: The order service writes once under an idempotency key; the edge dedupes retries from phones, stores and partners.
steps.presenterNote: Checkout does one thing and answers immediately. It never waits for a carrier or the tax office.

steps.title: Everyone else is told
steps.caption: The order is announced once on a shared feed, and every other part listens instead of being called.
steps.engineering: Transactional outbox to the event bus; one canonical order.v4 contract, versioned and contract-tested.
steps.presenterNote: Instead of checkout calling five systems, it announces the order once and they all listen.

steps.title: Busy days become a queue
steps.caption: On Black Friday the warehouse falls a few minutes behind and catches up, and checkout never slows down.
steps.engineering: Consumers autoscale on lag; a spike becomes backlog instead of timeouts.
steps.presenterNote: A spike becomes a short line, not an outage.

steps.title: A slow partner fails alone
steps.caption: When a carrier stops answering, only its orders wait, set aside safely until it recovers.
steps.engineering: One adapter per carrier with a circuit breaker; failures park in a DLQ with their keys and replay after a dry run.
steps.presenterNote: One slow carrier used to break checkout for everyone. Now only that carrier's orders wait, and nothing is lost.

steps.title: Safe to send twice
steps.caption: Tax invoices can be sent again after an outage without ever creating a duplicate.
steps.engineering: Idempotent batch keyed by invoice number; the authority's timeouts become retries, not duplicates.
steps.presenterNote: Anything that talks to the outside world has to be safe to repeat.

steps.title: AI suggests, people approve
steps.caption: An assistant watches the feed, spots problems and suggests a fix; a person approves every change.
steps.engineering: Agents consume the same events; proposals carry retrieved context and pass an approval step with an audit log.
steps.presenterNote: The assistant saves the digging, and a person keeps the decision.
